_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the ACI framework values the site renders: capabilities, aspects, AI architectures, offers and avoids, modes, excitations, taglines, philosophies, colors, and the convergence layer. Pages (Part I learn matrix, capability cards, the Gauge, the studio) read from here so wording changes in one place and stays aligned with the book.
sources: Archetype-Cards-Artist-Handoff.docx (finalized cards, artist handoff) — authoritative for taglines, modes, excitations, offers/avoids, and the model line.
QA_master-vs-final-archetype-definitions_2026-08-11.md — the Chapter 5 reframe and offers/avoids changes.
Figure 5.3 and Figure P1.2 (ACI_Figures_FINAL copy) — the Mens/Membra/Manus axis scheme and aspects.
notes: The printed Figure 5.3 and P1.2 still show the OLD offers/avoids (presence, struggle, inquiry, synthesis); the finalized cards supersede the figures per the QA (item C1). Values here follow the cards.

Mode names are the finalized card names (Engagement/Extension, etc.), which supersede the descriptive mode names in the June PDF Appendix and v0.3 Gauge spec (Meet What Resists, Stay Porous to the Field, etc.).

Card mode positions: Mode 1 is left, Mode 2 is right. On Figure P1.2 the horizontal Membra poles are Disposition (left, receptive) and Orientation (right, projective). The Mens-versus-Membra attribution of the capability modes is described differently across sources; confirm before labeling axes in copy.
Expressive Influence works on 'the crowd,' not 'the field'; 'field' is reserved for Part I.
Chinese renderings beyond the two Council terms are owned by Yilin with the SUES ACI Lab (locked bilingual glossary).

projective.name: Coherence

carrying it through to the close

capabilities.tagline: Move the crowd that moves you

projective.name: Expression

convergence.name: The Creative Council
convergence.aspect: Shape, Style, Story, Statement, held at once

convergence.note: Convergence is the machine's seductive offer, not the goal. The Council holds the four in contest and integrates through the practitioner's judgment. It does not average, route, or vote.
